verdict.rationale: GrowthBook documents its own REST API, and at least one endpoint uses a versioned path (`GET /v1/experiments/{id}/results`), so the API is versioned. The evidence never mentions a deprecation policy, version lifecycle, changelog, or sunset timelines, so only half the story is shown, and only thinly. Missing for 10: a documented API deprecation policy, explicit API versioning documentation beyond the /v1 path prefix, and independent corroboration of version stability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy

citations.quote: Get results for an experiment (`GET /v1/experiments/{id}/results`) to pull the latest analysis into your own reporting.
GrowthBook offers a full REST API for interacting with the application.
